meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 会新增微信渠道：用个人微信扫码登录，通过腾讯官方 iLink API 长轮询实时收发消息，无需配置 API 密钥或 webhook。微信消息会交给 Claude 处理并回复。
howto.when: 当微信好友或群成员向已接线的机器人账号发送消息时触发；管理员启动服务并扫码登录后，连接即建立。

say.note: 在微信里发给机器人，Claude 会回复。

say.text: 帮我总结一下这个链接的内容
say.note: 微信内发送，Claude 处理并回传摘要。
Claude 会记住并按时提醒。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw gains a WeChat channel: you scan a QR code with your personal WeChat, and it sends/receives messages via Tencent's official iLink API using long-polling. No API key or webhook needed. Incoming WeChat messages are handled by Claude, which replies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a WeChat contact or group member sends a message to the wired bot account. The connection is established after the admin starts the service and scans the QR code.

say_en.note: Send this to the bot on WeChat; Claude will reply.
Sent via WeChat; Claude processes and returns a summary.

say_en.text: Remind me to meet at 8pm tonight
say_en.note: Claude will remember and notify you on time.
